name: NFL Pack Opening RNG
desc:
🏈 Welcome to American Football Pack Opening!

Step into the ultimate football card experience—open packs, collect legendary players, and rise through the ranks!

 -- How to play --
📦 Collect & Trade: Unlock powerful cards, sell them for cash, and build your dream collection.
🏆 Climb the Leaderboards: Compete for a spot in the Top 100 for Cash, Inventory Value, and Play Time!
💰 Bonus Code: 500KVISITS to receive bonus cash! Next code will be released at 1K likes!
🛠️ New features coming soon!

BATTLE SYSTEM IS RELEASED AND FIXED!

🎮 Join our group, Fortune Factors Studio, to stay updated on major announcements and exclusive rewards.
💾 Your progress is saved cards and cash carry over every session.

🧪 This game is currently in beta. Expect frequent updates and improvements!*
